title: Restricted-weight free samples
statement: Let $n$ be the dimension of a restricted-weight input and let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. For each index in the sample set determined by the inner input, take the corresponding generator sample and project it onto the coordinates in $J$, obtaining an element of $\mathbb{F}_2^J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the input's coordinate indices
caveat: The coordinate projection and generator-sample constructions are not defined in the supplied definitions.
